name: Paranoid
storyline:
Five years after a horrible accident, our hero Michael is still struggling with his past mistake. Sure, he has a new lovely girlfriend, the extended family that comes with it - and he's ready to leave the dark behind and move on.
But as a new dawn arises, he gets the feeling that the house he wakes up in holds its own sinister secrets
summary: Paranoid is a highly acclaimed dark suburban mystery text based game and interactive fiction experience, starring Michael - your friendly neighborhood jockey, and Anna, the girl of his dreams.
